description: Rebrand normahq/mcp-dump Go module, CLI entrypoint, Taskfile, omnidist configuration, workflows, documentation, and directory to baldaworks/mcpdump. Create GitHub repository baldaworks/mcpdump, push main branch, and publish release to GitHub Releases and npm.
design:
### Architecture and Design
1. Module and Codebase:
   - Module: github.com/baldaworks/mcpdump in go.mod
   - Go toolchain: 1.26.6 with clean govulncheck
   - Directory cmd/mcp-dump -> cmd/mcpdump
   - Cobra CLI usage: mcpdump [--json] -- <mcp-server-cmd> [args...]
   - Implementation client name in internal/apps/mcpdump: mcpdump
2. Distribution:
   - Taskfile: BINARY_NAME=mcpdump, MAIN_PATH=./cmd/mcpdump
   - Omnidist: profile mcpdump, package @baldaworks/mcpdump, repo git+https://github.com/baldaworks/mcpdump.git
   - Workflows: omnidist-release.yml with bin stripping script, NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN secret
3. Git and GitHub:
   - Create repo baldaworks/mcpdump, configure origin remote, rename folder to /home/bigboss/Projects/mcpdump
4. Release:
   - Tag v1.0.1 and publish to GitHub Releases and npm
acceptance_criteria:

- Documentation in README.md and AGENTS.md updated to baldaworks/mcpdump.
- GitHub repository baldaworks/mcpdump created, remote updated, and directory renamed to /home/bigboss/Projects/mcpdump.
